# Ken Suya

> Suya specialist in Birmingham, UK. Beef, chicken and lamb suya hand-rolled in signature yaji spice and grilled fresh to order. Order via WhatsApp, phone or Instagram for collection or delivery. No app or account needed.

Ken Suya is a Birmingham-based street food business specialising in suya, thin-sliced, spice-crusted meat skewers grilled over an open flame. All yaji spice (roasted peanut, ginger, garlic, cayenne) is roasted and ground in-house.

## Ordering

- Orders are placed via phone or WhatsApp (+44 7960 235758) or Instagram DM (@KenSuya). There is no online checkout or app.
- Both collection and delivery are available across Birmingham.
- Ordering hours: Tue–Thu 16:00–21:00, Fri–Sat 12:00–23:00, Sun 13:00–20:00. Closed Monday.

## Menu

- Beef Suya: £12.00. The signature dish, thin-sliced beef hand-rolled in yaji and grilled over open flame.
- Lamb: £10.00. Tender lamb, double-dusted in yaji, char-grilled.
- Chopped Chicken: £10.00. Juicy chicken, chopped and tossed in yaji, grilled hot, finished with onion and tomato.
- Chicken Skewers: 4 for £10.00. Grilled chicken skewers built for sharing.
- Plantain: £2.50 per portion. Sweet fried plantain.
- Corn: £3.00. Grilled corn on the cob, brushed with butter and yaji.

## Location

Unit 4, Greenfield Business Park, Birmingham, B11 2AA, UK. Collection and delivery only, no dine-in seating.
